reflection: What happened in the silence? Write it without interpreting it.
Which of the "release is not" statements did you most need to hear? Which have you been confusing with forgiveness, and how has that confusion kept you from it?
What safety measure, boundary, report, or consequence will remain in place whatever you release? Write it down. Naming it may make release possible.
If you have been punishing yourself, which of the four (conviction, shame, consequence, self- punishment) is actually at work? What would it mean to accept Romans 8:1 as the verdict?
